title: Late Fees on Invoiced Mold Remediation Balances
content:
The job must be in invoiced status when a late fee is charged on a Mold Remediation job. A late fee may post only after the grace period following the payment due date recorded at invoicing has fully passed. The grace period is counted in calendar days starting the day after the payment due date, and the first late fee may post on the day after the grace period's last day. A late fee is assessed at most once per calendar month fee period at the late fee percentage of the balance due, with the late fee minimum as a floor, rounded to the cent, half up.

No late fee posts on an insurance claim job while its linked claim file is in opened, estimate submitted or approved status and the suspension period counted from the invoice date has not ended. Late fees are never back-dated to a suspended period, and a job with a zero or negative balance is never charged a late fee.

## Grace period

- Starts: the day after the payment due date recorded at invoicing.
- Length: the tier's late fee grace days, in calendar days.
- First possible late fee: the day after the grace period's last day. On the grace period's last day itself no late fee may post.

Hypothetical: due date 5 August, 10 grace days. The grace period runs 6 to 15 August; the first late fee may post on 16 August.

## Amount

The late fee is the higher of the late fee minimum and the late fee percentage of the balance due, rounded to the cent, half up; it is assessed at most once per calendar month fee period.

| Hypothetical balance due | Percentage at 1.5 | Late fee |
|---|---|---|
| 3200.00 | 48.00 | 48.00 |
| 900.00 | 13.50 | 25.00 (minimum) |
| 0.00 or below | — | None |

## Suspension on claim-funded jobs

All of these together suspend the late fee: the job is insurance claim funded; its linked claim file is in opened, estimate submitted or approved status; and the suspension period, counted from the invoice date, has not ended. The claim file's status is read on the Insurance Claim Services file the job is linked to. Once the suspension ends, no late fee is back-dated to the suspended period.
